messages:
lucy: Heads-up, saw weird behavior in the onboarding sample: lots of small paged embedding requests + STS rotation -> sustained 429s and duplicate page processing. node vs go sdk differ again.
ben: do you have a quick repro? sounds like retry waves due to fixed backoff.
lucy: repro steps: prefetch=3, concurrency=5, burst to 80rps for 20s, force token rotate. Node shows retries all at 250ms fixed delay, go had jittered retries so fewer duplicates. logs:

lucy: ```
[2026-03-18T09:10:01Z] 429 embed.fetch id=abc retrying in 250ms
[2026-03-18T09:10:01Z] 429 embed.fetch id=def retrying in 250ms
[2026-03-18T09:10:02Z] INFO duplicate page read id=abc page=2
```

kai: that fixed 250ms is the issue. Node SDK default retry config is deterministic. we should add jitter by default to avoid head-of-line retry storms.
ciara: also the sample's checkpointing only after page processed means prefetched pages get requeued on retry. two mitigations: optimistic checkpoint when enqueue or lease token per page to prevent re-reads.
ben: can we do a minimal change in sampleapp now: add small rand jitter (+-20%) and change checkpoint to save after enqueue for prefetch mode? cheap and low risk.
kai: for SDK parity, i'll open an issue to expose AbortSignal per request and switch to jittered exp backoff in node sdk. will include benchmark notes from go-sdk.
ciara: also add request-id to retry logs and backoff ms so triage is easier.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy passed for sampleapp-v3 at 2026-03-18T09:20:00Z :white_check_mark:
ben: plan: (1) sampleapp quick fix (jitter + optimistic checkpoint) (2) node-sdk issue for AbortSignal + default jitter (3) add devex note about prefetch defaults (prefetch<=1 for short-lived tokens).
lucy: i'll send the sampleapp PR and run a 30m perf to confirm. thanks all.
